Rooms.Name: On The Swift Flowing River
Rooms.Description:
The deep river flows east and west through a dense forest.  Over the
ages, the river has cut through the bedrock to form a particularly deep
channel for itself.  The banks of the river are very steep, and appear to
be very slippery, so it would be quite impossible to leave the river and
enter the forest.

Rooms.Name: The Riverbank
Rooms.Description:
The river is deep, and runs swiftly in an east-west direction.  To 
the north the river eddies and enters a backwash where a small bank 
extends down from a dark, thick stand of trees.  However, it doesn't 
look particularly inviting.

Rooms.Name: The Twisty Part Of The River
Rooms.Description:
The river twists and turns and nearly tosses you out of your boat.
The water is dark, cold, almost reptilian in sheen.  It seems almost
alive.  The river runs east and south.

Rooms.Name: The Scenic Route
Rooms.Description:
The dark forest of Haon-Dor recedes behind you to the northeast.
The river continues in a westerly direction toward the river delta,
where you can just make out a large island.

Rooms.Name: The Swift River Delta
Rooms.Description:
You are at the edge of the river delta, where the river empties
out on its way to the sea.  The water here is Black.  Deep.  Dark.
Deadly.  The tidal waves sweep you around and around up and down.

Rooms.Name: Near The Rocks
Rooms.Description:
You bob up and down in the waves, coming dangerously close to some
large, jagged rocks on the eastern shore of an unusual looking island.
There is no way you could possibly land there without getting killed.

Rooms.Name: The South River Delta
Rooms.Description:
You are making your way along a channel in the river delta between
the island to the west and the shore to the south and east.  To the
south an aging, run down looking pier juts out from land. Toward the 
west the channel works it way close to the island as it moves around
its southern tip.

Rooms.Name: The Pier
Rooms.Description:
You float next to a crumbling pier long since neglected. To the west 
the water gets sluggish and there are many weeds and some seaweed 
floating about.

Rooms.Name: Mired In Seaweed
Rooms.Description:
The going is rough here.  The tide struggles with the normal flow
of the river and here near the edge of the sea there is a large
amount of growth.  To the west the channel passes the southern tip of
the island and heads for open waters.

Rooms.Name: The Last Stop
Rooms.Description:
The delta meets the sea here.  To the west you see nothing but
ocean on the horizon.  Sea birds squawk noisily at your approach
and take flight from a nearby beach head on the island.  It looks
as though this could be the last stop for those heading out to sea.

Rooms.Name: The Beach Head
Rooms.Description:
This is a secluded looking beach on the southern tip of the island.
There isn't much to see here and there is no way to cross the steep
rocky cliffs that wall in this place.

Rooms.Name: The North Channel
Rooms.Description:
The river splits and runs up against the island and a navigable
channel slips off to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: The North Channel
Rooms.Description:
The river current carries you swiftly westward as the channel
begins to narrow as it squeezes past the north end of the island.

Rooms.Name: Near The Isle
Rooms.Description:
You are sitting just off a small landing on the island that 
appears to be nothing more than a short path that leads to the
side of a hill.

Rooms.Name: The Lane Of The Lying
Rooms.Description:
Bodies lie everywhere.  Commoner, peasant, duke, duchess.  The Gods
will not hear your call here, hence they will not answer you.  To the
south the path ends at a dark cave entrance.
A sign has been posted beside the entrance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sign beside the dark cave opening reads:

   WARNING! Only fools and dead people pass this way.
   The tests of Crete, our glorious ruler, await.

Rooms.Name: The First Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
Ah... you find yourself in Crete's battlefield playground.  Crete 
loves to torture his people through these places.  He collects the 
monsters of the world and puts them here.

Rooms.Name: The Second Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
Crete's voice reverberates from the four walls of this room:
'Get some rest and make sure you're healed.  You'll need it for
the next monster in my playground.  Or are you strong enough?'
To the south is the entrance to the next challenge of Crete's
stronghold.

Rooms.Name: The Third Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
You go inside a red room.  Very red.  As if the Crete King used
them to disembowel his guests.  The path continues eastward.  You
see blue lights in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The Fourth Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
Crete must be a monster hacking machine.  You see a blue light
flicker on and off.  A voice crackles, 'WHY ARE YOU HERE!'

Rooms.Name: The Fifth Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
This is General Woundwort's quarters.  Hraka abound.  The frayed
corpses of rabbits lie scattered about this hell-hole.  The General
is not a very neat person as you can tell.

Rooms.Name: The Sixth Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
Dare we surmise how many more rooms Crete has?  The paths appear to 
be endless.  You shudder as the sounds of death cries from the east.  
A loud voice bellows another warning: 'Leave now or face my wrath!' 
There is a crawlway leading upwards at the far end of the room and 
there is a fresh breeze coming from there.

Rooms.Name: The Final Trial Of Crete
Rooms.Description:
This is Minos' room.  What else did you expect?  The room is lavishly
decorated for this bovine king.  Everything is so opulent that it makes
your eyes bulge.  Survive and reap his fortune!  The only exit is a 
large oak door in the east wall.

Exits.Description: You see a rather large oak door bound with iron and securely locked.

Rooms.Name: The Royal Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The treasure room of Crete is dark save for your lantern.  
Hopefully it has not been looted yet by the many legendary 
thieves of Midgaard. A clever looking secret passage leads 
upward from here.

Rooms.Name: Above, On The Beach
Rooms.Description:
You sit amongst the rocks above a small beach at the southern end 
of the island.  You could clamber down easy enough, but getting back 
up would be another story.

Mobs.Name: homba
Mobs.Description: Part kestrel, part bear, part wolf.  Parts is parts, and makes an ugly whole.

Mobs.Name: swordsman
Mobs.LongDescription: The greatest swordsman in the land is standing here with a sneer on his face.

Mobs.Name: mummy rabscuttle
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mummy of Rabscuttle wanders here, hands aloft, walking towards you.

Mobs.Name: lizard giant
Mobs.Description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to its underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

Mobs.Name: woundwort general demon
Mobs.LongDescription: General Woundwort, the dark demon of Crete, awaits to maul you to shreds.
Mobs.Description: He looks vaguely like a rabbit, but sure doesn't act like one.

Mobs.Name: franz henchman
Mobs.LongDescription: Franz, Minos' henchman, is here ready to pump you up.
Mobs.Description:
Franz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could
squeeze your head like a grapefruit.

Mobs.Name: hanz henchman
Mobs.LongDescription: Hanz is here flexing his muscles and squeezing grapefruits.
Mobs.Description:
Hanz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could
lift a large dragon.

Mobs.Name: minos king minotaur
Mobs.LongDescription: King Crete the Minotaur is ready and waiting to gore you to death.

Mobs.Name: hag sea
Mobs.LongDescription: You notice the face of an ugly hag in the sea weeds.
Mobs.Description: The sea hag is terribly fightful and has razor sharp teeth.

Mobs.Name: merman
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a merman swimming here brandishing his trident at you!
Mobs.Description: The merman has a powerful tail fin instead of legs.

Mobs.Name: crab crusty
Mobs.LongDescription: A crusty looking crab is crawling around here searching for food.
Mobs.Description: It looks like a carb... what more can be said?

Objects.Name: key golden heavy
Objects.Description: A heavy golden key lies here.

Objects.Name: shield minotaur
Objects.Description: A dark minotaur shield has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A strong, sturdy shield.  It brings to mind legends of a shield that
provided protection from poisonous gases.

Objects.Name: gauntlets troll
Objects.Description: A pair of gauntlets made from troll skin lie on the ground.

Objects.Name: ring platinum
Objects.Description: A shining ring of platinum lies here.  It has a tiny inscription.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The inscription on the ring reads:
Cursed be the gods that supply coins to mortals!
And cursed be the mortal that accepts valuable gifts from the gods!
Especially cursed are those who do not leave the toilet seat up!

Objects.Name: flail
Objects.Description: A flail has been carelessly left here.

Objects.Name: coins gold treasure
Objects.Description: A great, gleaming pile of treasure lies at your feet.

Objects.Name: spear heavy
Objects.Description: A heavy spear has been tossed on the ground here.

Objects.Name: trident
Objects.Description: There is a warrior's trident here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a common trident, often used by gladiators or mermen.  It has
three sharp prongs jutting from the business end and a smooth wooden
handle with two comfortable grip points.

Objects.Name: boots boat
Objects.Description: A pair of boots sit here in a puddle of water.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots are made of a strange lightweight hide and float in a puddle
of water.
